P2.primary_cases: first no-progress window per episode, not selected by outcome
P2.candidate_controls: every 10 steps in successful same-protocol/n/layout trajectory, start>=20, end+20<=T
P2.visibility: required validated same-object visibility at start; absent means no qualified match. Compute geometric provisional matches only, never pass gate.
P2.selection: prefer different episode, ascending sum normalized feature errors, tie episode id/start. No within-window or future outcome in matching.
P2.normal_confirmation_offline: next 20 steps after window: at least one object improves >=.01 m and no fall; confirmation after matching, never rematch according to outcome

P1.analysis_scope: one complete audit pass; no expanding descriptive samples if G1 fails

P3.fall: z<.975 for5 controls; episode any rule and per-object first runs
P3.bbox: rotated cube .035m, true table x+/-.25 y+/-.30
P3.causal_velocity: strictly before first bbox crossing, never post-fall speed
P3.ordering: control samples vs physical .01667s labelled separately
